objective: Launch a running-shoe brand whose every sustainability claim is verifiable, converting greenwashing-fatigued runners into first adopters — 10,000 pairs in year one with zero retracted claims.
audience: Serious recreational runners, 25–45, logging 20+ miles a week: data-literate, Strava-native, burned before by 'eco' marketing, treating unverifiable green claims as disqualifying.
key_message: Don't take our word for it. Read the receipt.
tone: Plainspoken, precise, lightly wry; numbers before adjectives; confident enough to publish its own failures.
mandatories: Every sustainability claim must carry its number and its audit source
Banned vocabulary unless directly quantified: eco-friendly, green, natural, planet-first, conscious
Performance claims must be verified against category benchmarks before publication
All candidate brand names are unscreened for trademark and must be marked as such
Include the AI-assist disclosure on all concept materials
